scope: Conditional fiscal calibration plus structural screening and paired exploratory policy pilot; not full national validation
selection: Minimum absolute difference between 12-month sum of realized tax and sum of domestic value added and 0.148, averaged over training seeds. Growth, investment and policy results are not optimized.
acceptance: Fitting one lumped fiscal ratio alone does not establish empirical validity. Do not promote a candidate to public defaults if coverage/measurement or baseline-dynamics checks fail.
uncertainty: Five event-seed holdouts conditional on one initial society. Report paired seed ranges and sample SD; no population confidence intervals, identification claims or policy rankings.
units: Fiscal shares use sums of same-period fixed-price normalized amounts. Real GDP growth is a loose plausibility screen. National investment and firm survey estimates lack exact model scope and are not fitted.
android: No Android certification; record Node runtime and memory only.
